verdict.rationale: Trello's own site documents pre-built templates from industry leaders and the Trello community as a 'blueprint for success,' which directly covers starting a project from a template. The only evidence is a single marketing line, with no detail on the template catalog or how templates are applied. Missing for 10: documentation of the template gallery and how a template is used to create a board, product-management-specific templates, and independent or hands-on corroboration of template use.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates

citations.quote: Give your team a blueprint for success with easy-to-use templates from industry leaders and the Trello community.
